jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern
jobs.description:
Full Stack Developer Intern  

\*\*Company:\*\* Reward360 (R360\) Global Services
\*\*Location:\*\* Bangalore (on\-site)
\*\*Experience:\*\* 0 \- 1 years
\*\*Stack:\*\* Django · PostgreSQL · React · TypeScript · AWS  

About R360  

R360 builds the loyalty, rewards, and customer engagement platform behind some of India's largest card issuers—HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Standard Chartered, Kotak Mahindra Bank, and IndusInd Bank—as well as enterprise clients across BFSI and consumer brands.  

We are not a rewards catalogue. We build the commerce, points, and engagement infrastructure that powers millions of customer interactions inside regulated environments where correctness, reliability, and performance matter.  

What you'll do  

Build real product features across a Django/PostgreSQL backend and a React/TypeScript frontend.  

Develop APIs that integrate with banking systems, mobile apps, and partner platforms.  

Work with PostgreSQL to design schemas, write efficient queries, and understand how production databases evolve.  

Deploy and test applications on AWS with guidance from the engineering team.  

Debug issues across the stack—from frontend UI bugs to backend services and database queries.  

Collaborate with engineers, product, and design teams to turn requirements into working software.  

Write clean, maintainable code, tests where they add value, and documentation that helps the next person understand your work.  

You won't be working on toy projects—you'll contribute to software used by millions of banking customers.  

Must have  

0–1 years of experience, including internships, academic projects, or strong personal projects.  

Working knowledge of Python and Django.  

Familiarity with React and TypeScript (or JavaScript with a willingness to learn TypeScript).  

Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or relational databases.  

Comfortable with Git and collaborative development workflows.  

Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, HTTP, REST APIs, and basic authentication concepts.  

Curiosity to learn production engineering practices and work in an existing codebase.  

Good to have  

Experience with AWS, Docker, or CI/CD through projects or internships.  

Built and deployed a full\-stack project that you can walk us through.  

Exposure to fintech, payments, loyalty systems, or high\-volume applications.  

Familiarity with LLM\-based developer tools like GitHub Copilot or Claude Code.  

What we look for  

Ownership. You finish what you start and ask good questions when you're blocked.  

Curiosity. You want to understand why something works, not just make it pass.  

Clear communication. You can explain your approach and discuss trade\-offs.  

Attention to detail. Small mistakes matter when software touches customer transactions.  

Learning mindset. You're comfortable receiving feedback and improving quickly.  

Why this role  

Work alongside experienced engineers on production systems used by millions.  

Learn full\-stack development across backend, frontend, databases, and cloud infrastructure.  

Get hands\-on exposure to real\-world engineering constraints—scale, reliability, and regulated environments.  

Join a small engineering team where your work ships and your contributions are visible from day one.

jobs.title: software developer Internship
jobs.description:
**Software Developer Intern – Full Stack \& Mobile**

*3\-Month Internship \| Opportunity for Full\-Time Conversion*

Start date: Immediate or at the earliestEmployment type: Full\-time internship

**About Spinor**

Spinor is building a hyperlocal online\-ordering and fulfillment platform consisting of a customer\-facing ordering website and a vendor/kitchen operations application. Customers can browse menus and offers, place orders and track their status, while vendor teams can receive live orders, update preparation status, manage pickup and dispatch, and monitor fulfillment timing.

**About the Internship**

We are looking for a motivated Software Developer Intern to work with our core team on the Spinor vendor application and online\-ordering platform.

This is a hands\-on development role. You will contribute to production features, solve real operational problems, fix bugs and help improve the reliability and usability of our applications. You will work closely with the founders, product team and operations team to understand business requirements and convert them into working software.

The internship will initially be for three months. High\-performing interns may be offered a full\-time software developer position, based on performance, ownership, technical ability, team fit and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and improve features in the Spinor vendor application and customer ordering website.
* Build responsive and user\-friendly interfaces for web and mobile devices.
* Work on features such as: Vendor and customer authentication, Menu and product management, Product availability and stock status and many more...
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third\-party services.
* Work with authentication, OTP, payment\-gateway and push\-notification integrations.
* Identify, reproduce and resolve application bugs.
* Improve application performance, reliability and security.
* Write clean, reusable and maintainable code.
* Test features before they are released to production.
* Use Git for version control and participate in code reviews.
* Maintain basic technical documentation for developed features and APIs.
* Coordinate with the operations team to understand real vendor and customer problems.
* Assist with staging, production deployment and post\-release monitoring.

**Technology Stack**

The intern will work with a modern web, mobile and backend technology stack, including:

FrontEnd Skills:

* ReactNative
* Swift
* kotlin
* graphQL
* WebSockets
* NextJS

Backend Skills

* SpringBoot
* fastAPI
* RESTful APIs and JSON

Database and Cloud Services

* MongoDB
* Firebase
* Cassandra
* AWS S3, AWS Lamda, AWS EC2, AWS cloudfront
* Logging, error monitoring and basic analytics

Development Tools

* Git, GitHub, GitLab
* Postman
* Visual Studio Code
* Browser developer tools
* Android Studio where required
* CI/CD and cloud deployment tools

Applicants are not expected to know every technology listed above. Strong knowledge of at least one frontend, mobile or backend technology, together with the ability to learn quickly, is more important.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of programming fundamentals.
* Understanding of APIs, JSON and asynchronous programming.
* Basic knowledge of databases and data modelling.
* Familiarity with Git and version\-control workflows.
* Ability to debug problems independently.
* Ability to write readable and structured code.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned work and complete it within agreed timelines.

Preferred Qualifications

* Final\-year student, recent graduate or postgraduate in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, BCA, MCA, BE, BTech or a related field.
* Candidates from other educational backgrounds may also apply if they have a strong project portfolio.
* Previous internship, freelance or personal\-project experience in web or mobile development.
* Experience building and deploying at least one complete application.
* GitHub profile, portfolio website or working project demonstrations.
* Familiarity with e\-commerce, food ordering, POS, logistics or order\-management applications.
* Experience with payment gateways, OTP authentication, Firebase notifications or real\-time applications.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX and responsive design.
* Basic knowledge of application security and performance optimisation.

What We Look For

We value practical ability and ownership more than certificates. The ideal candidate:

* Enjoys building working products rather than only completing tutorials.
* Can understand an existing codebase and make changes carefully.
* Tests their work before marking it complete.
* Communicates blockers early and clearly.
* Is comfortable receiving feedback through code reviews.
* Pays attention to customer and vendor experience.
* Takes responsibility for the quality of delivered work.
* Is interested in continuing with Spinor in a full\-time role after the internship.

What the Intern Will Gain

* Experience working on a live ordering and vendor\-management platform.
* Exposure to customer\-facing and operational software.
* End\-to\-end experience from requirement gathering to deployment.
* Practical experience with APIs, databases, mobile applications and web applications.
* Direct interaction with the founding, product and operations teams.
* Experience solving real business and customer problems.
* Opportunity to take ownership of production\-facing features.
* Consideration for a full\-time software developer position after the internship.

Full\-Time Conversion

At the end of the three\-month internship, performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and reliability of delivered code
* Ability to complete assigned features
* Problem\-solving and debugging ability
* Speed of learning
* Testing discip
